areas.name: Biomedical AI
areas.scope: Machine learning and computational methods for clinical imaging, digital pathology, microscopy, neuroimaging, health records, physiological signals, and biomedical data analysis.

families.name: Clinical Prediction from Health Records
families.scope: Predictive modeling over electronic health records, clinical codes, and claims for diagnosis, risk, readmission, treatment, and outcome prediction.

families.name: Drug Discovery and Development
families.scope: Computational drug discovery and pharmaceutical development: target/ADMET prediction, drug toxicity and interaction (DDI), drug repurposing, mechanism-of-action, drug labeling, pharmacogenomics, drug knowledgebases and ontologies, and medicinal-chemistry property prediction. Distinct from clinical predictive modeling over health records.

areas.name: Scientific Computing
areas.scope: Scientific software, simulation, optimization, and machine learning for proteins, molecules, materials, genomics, physics, Earth systems, energy, geoscience, quantum systems, neuroscience, astronomy, and population models.

families.name: Protein Modeling
families.scope: Protein and biomolecular-complex structure prediction, folding, inverse folding, sequence-to-structure modeling, and computational protein design.

families.name: Molecular Informatics
families.scope: Molecular representations, property prediction, generative chemistry, docking, synthesis planning, cheminformatics, fingerprints, and substructure analysis for small molecules and drugs.

families.name: Materials Informatics
families.scope: Data structures, property prediction, atomistic learning, generative design, simulation preparation, and analysis for crystals, inorganic compounds, and engineered materials.

families.name: Molecular Simulation
families.scope: Molecular dynamics, force fields, enhanced sampling, free-energy calculation, and simulation engines for biomolecules, small molecules, and atomistic systems.

families.name: Genomics and Bioinformatics
families.scope: Genomic sequence analysis, variant calling, single-cell and spatial omics, differential expression, biological data structures, and bioinformatics workflows.

families.name: Quantum Computing
families.scope: Quantum circuits, simulators, execution frameworks, algorithms, and hybrid quantum-classical learning.

families.name: Biomolecular Visualization
families.scope: Interactive 3D visualization and rendering of proteins, nucleic acids, molecular trajectories, and electron-microscopy density maps.

families.name: Quantum Chemistry
families.scope: Electronic-structure and quantum-chemistry computational methods and workflows: density-functional theory (DFT), ab initio and semi-empirical methods, XTB, geometry optimization, and post-Hartree-Fock calculations for atoms, molecules, crystals, and reaction systems. Distinct from Quantum Computing (qubit circuits, simulators, and quantum algorithms).
